question: Sodium hydrogen carbonate is called:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Baking soda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sodium hydrogen carbonate** is commonly known as **baking soda**.
 
• It is a chemical compound with the formula **NaHCO3**.
 
• Baking soda is a **white crystalline powder** that is commonly used as a leavening agent in baking.
 
• It is also used in various household applications such as **cleaning and odor neutralization**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Washing soda**

 
 
• Also known as **sodium carbonate** (Na2CO3).
 
• Used in laundry detergents and as a water softener.
 
• It is not the same as baking soda and has different chemical properties and uses.
 
 
 
• **Gypsum**
 
 
• A soft sulfate mineral composed of **calcium sulfate dihydrate** (CaSO4·2H2O).
 
• Used in construction (e.g., drywall) and as a fertilizer.
 
 
 
• **Plaster of Paris**
 
 
• A quick-setting gypsum plaster consisting of a fine white powder (calcium sulfate hemihydrate).
 
• Used for making sculptures, casts, and medical bandages for setting broken bones.
